## Goal
Cut rebar 0.15.0 from current `main`, following docs/releasing.md (steps 1, 1a, 2, then verify 3-5). 0.14.0 (2026-10-30) is the latest on PyPI, GitHub Releases and the MCP Registry, and `main` carries 143 commits since v0.14.0.

Why a minor (0.15.0), not a patch: `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md holds 2 entries marked BREAKING (pre-1.0) — the retired warn-class config/env tombstones (e21f3240cd0) and the removed canary `github-api` heartbeat source (73e90b296e2). docs/api-stability.md puts pre-1.0 breaking changes in a minor release, and no earlier patch release carried a BREAKING entry.

## Preconditions (checked 2026-11-09)
- `release.yml` publishes PyPI and the MCP Registry through OIDC; no stored secret is needed. The `pypi` environment requires reviewer JoeOakhartNava and allows only the `main` branch; `gh` is authenticated as JoeOakhartNava.
- Version is carried by pyproject.toml `[project].version`, server.json top-level `version` and every `packages[].version`, uv.lock (root package entry) and tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json (`__version__`).
- Homebrew tap `navapbc/homebrew-rebar`: `Formula/rebar.rb` is at 0.13.1, and `autobump.yml` is in state `disabled_inactivity` (last run 2026-10-28). It cannot be dispatched until a maintainer re-enables it; re-enabling is a repository setting outside this ticket's authority, so it is escalated to the operator rather than done here.

## Plan
1. Bump 0.14.0 -> 0.15.0 in lockstep: pyproject.toml `version`; server.json top-level `version` and every `packages[].version`.
2. `uv lock`, then `make install` (so the editable install reports 0.15.0), then `python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --update`. Check `git diff` shows only version changes in uv.lock and only the `__version__` value in tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json.
3. CHANGELOG.md: `[Unreleased]` is already curated, so retitle it `## [0.15.0] - 2026-11-09` (no `make changelog`), open a fresh empty `## [Unreleased]` above it, and add a `[0.15.0]: .../compare/v0.14.0...v0.15.0` footer link. Hand-curate: add user-facing fixes merged since v0.14.0 that the section does not yet cover, keep both entries marked BREAKING, no ticket noise, no financial figures.
4. One commit with a `rebar-ticket:` trailer for this ticket and a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
5. Local checks: `env -u JIRA_URL -u JIRA_USER -u JIRA_API_TOKEN make verify` (no timeout) and `python -m build && python -m twine check dist/*`.
6. `git push gerrit HEAD:refs/for/main%hashtag=rebar-session-a85e3cd3-9e61-4f25-9de4-cd740e853b4d` (not WIP). At LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 and 0 unresolved comments, land with `scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py <n> --revision <full sha>`; wait for the GitHub mirror's `main` to contain the merged commit.
7. `gh workflow run release.yml --ref main -f version=0.15.0`; watch the run; when it pauses at the `pypi` environment, approve via the runbook's `pending_deployments` REST call with the JSON body sent through `--input`.
8. Verify channels: PyPI JSON API, `gh release view v0.15.0`, the `mcp_registry` job result plus the registry search API, and Homebrew. Post-publish probe: `pipx install "nava-rebar[mcp]==0.15.0" --force`, then `REBAR=<pipx bin>/rebar python scripts/probe_rebar.py` (no `PROBE_LIVE`).

Failure handling: a release-run failure before publish is debugged and, if it needs a code fix, fixed through Gerrit and re-dispatched. After PyPI publishes, nothing is re-uploaded (PyPI is immutable): a failed later job (github_release, mcp_registry) is re-run with `gh run rerun <run> --failed`, both jobs being idempotent; a defective published artifact is reported for yank + new patch version.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] pyproject.toml, server.json (top-level and every packages[].version), uv.lock and tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json all carry 0.15.0, and CHANGELOG.md has a `## [0.15.0] - 2026-11-09` section that keeps both BREAKING entries, an empty `## [Unreleased]` above it, and a `[0.15.0]` compare link; the commit carries the rebar-ticket trailer and DCO sign-off.
- [x] `make verify` and `twine check` pass locally on the release commit.
- [x] [non-codebase] The release commit lands on `main` through Gerrit at LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; evidence: Gerrit change number and merged SHA, which the GitHub mirror's `main` contains.
      provenance: environment=production Gerrit rebar.solutions.navateam.com + GitHub mirror navapbc/rebar; principal=RebarBotNava (Gerrit REST) and JoeOakhartNava (gh); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read from the change's DETAILED_LABELS and git ls-remote of origin main after submit
- [x] [non-codebase] The `release.yml` run dispatched from `main` with version=0.15.0 completes with conclusion success; evidence: run id and per-job conclusions.
      provenance: environment=GitHub Actions navapbc/rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava (gh); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read via gh run view on the dispatched run
- [x] [non-codebase] PyPI serves nava-rebar 0.15.0; evidence: `info.version` from https://pypi.org/pypi/nava-rebar/json.
      provenance: environment=production pypi.org; principal=anonymous public JSON API; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read via curl of the public JSON API after publish
- [x] [non-codebase] GitHub Release v0.15.0 exists, is marked Latest, and has the sdist and wheel attached, with tag v0.15.0 at the released SHA; evidence: `gh release view v0.15.0`.
      provenance: environment=github.com navapbc/rebar Releases; principal=JoeOakhartNava (gh); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read via gh release view and gh api releases/latest
- [x] [non-codebase] The MCP Registry lists io.github.navapbc/rebar 0.15.0 as latest; evidence: the `mcp_registry` job conclusion and the registry search API response.
      provenance: environment=production registry.modelcontextprotocol.io; principal=anonymous public search API; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read via curl of the v0/servers search endpoint after the run
- [x] [non-codebase] Homebrew `Formula/rebar.rb` in navapbc/homebrew-rebar points at the 0.15.0 sdist, or, while autobump.yml stays disabled, the blocker is escalated to the operator and filed as a linked bug; evidence: the formula's url line or the bug id.
      provenance: environment=github.com navapbc/homebrew-rebar; principal=JoeOakhartNava (gh); privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — read via gh api contents of Formula/rebar.rb and the workflow state
- [x] [non-codebase] The post-publish probe against the pipx-installed 0.15.0 binary reports 0 failed; evidence: the `PROBE RESULT` line.
      provenance: environment=local macOS host, pipx venv installed from production PyPI; principal=local operator user; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — scripts/probe_rebar.py run against the pipx-installed binary

## Outcome (2026-11-09, times PST)
- Release commit fd2cae3925e3b05992cdad5ed53e4d85128ed78c (rebase of ab534d1b382 onto aa9828f9a2b; same Change-Id, rebar-ticket trailer and Signed-off-by). Local `make verify` passed on it: 20,850 passed / 29 skipped default tier, 202 passed / 2 skipped integration. Pinned release-toolchain build + `twine check` PASSED (wheel and sdist) on the bump; release.yml's build job re-ran the hash-locked build on fd2cae3925e.
- Gerrit change 3335 patch set 2: LLM-Review +1, Verified +1 (CI run 42738438802, 27 jobs success incl. all 7 mutation shards), no unresolved comments; submitted 18:17 via gerrit_safe_submit.py --revision fd2cae3925e3b05992cdad5ed53e4d85128ed78c, status MERGED; GitHub mirror main = fd2cae3925e at 18:17. Patch set 1 had Verified -1 from the ubuntu-26.04 mutation-sandbox defect (unwasteful-increased-colt, fixed by aa9828f9a2b).
- release.yml run 42741796277 dispatched from main (head fd2cae3925e) with version=0.15.0; pypi deployment approved 18:24 by JoeOakhartNava; conclusion success, all 10 jobs success (authorize, build, wheel/sdist tests, publish, mcp_registry, github_release, evidence).
- PyPI: info.version 0.15.0; files nava_rebar-0.15.0-py3-none-any.whl and nava_rebar-0.15.0.tar.gz.
- GitHub: Release v0.15.0, not draft/prerelease, releases/latest = v0.15.0, assets wheel + sdist + SHA256SUMS; tag v0.15.0 -> commit fd2cae3925e.
- MCP Registry: io.github.navapbc/rebar 0.15.0 isLatest=true, published 18:24.
- Homebrew: PENDING OPERATOR. Formula/rebar.rb still points at nava_rebar-0.13.1.tar.gz; autobump.yml is disabled_inactivity. Re-enabling it is the operator's decision; tracked in hedonistic-historical-graywolf (linked discovered_from). Not a release failure.
- Probe: `pipx install "nava-rebar[mcp]==0.15.0" --force` (installed 0.15.0, baked COMMIT fd2cae3), then scripts/probe_rebar.py with REBAR at the pipx binary, no PROBE_LIVE: PROBE RESULT: 142 passed, 0 failed (mode: ISOLATED (temp tracker)).
- Filed during the release: unwasteful-increased-colt (mutation sandbox, closed), hedonistic-historical-graywolf (Homebrew autobump), expansive-aromatic-whippet (local build/twine check false failure), inner-benign-sable (tag-type doc drift).

## File impact (expected)
- pyproject.toml
- server.json
- uv.lock
- tests/unit/api_surface_baseline.json
- CHANGELOG.md
